info.title: KeepSave core management API
info.description: Management contract for the candidate vault and harness-neutral platform. Feature flags default off for new platform surfaces. Configuration, synthetic validation, real provider/client acceptance, independent reviews and release availability are separate.

redirect_url.description: Exact pre-registered loopback callback, with state and issuer plus a sixty-second authorization code or access_denied. Never an access or refresh token.

resource.description: Required on both exchange and refresh; must exactly match the configured resource.

MCPTokenRequest.description: Public pre-registered client only; no secret, client assertion, Basic auth, dynamic registration or metadata URL fetching. Duplicate form fields and URL query parameters are rejected. authorization_code requires code, redirect_uri, code_verifier. refresh_token requires refresh_token; optional scope cannot change consent.

MCPRevocationRequest.description: Public client possession-based family revocation. Unknown tokens and client mismatch produce the same empty success; they grant no authority.

requires_refresh.description: Family remains live, but no unrotated access token is current. The native client must refresh before a browser run can bind it.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes; uppercase, lowercase, digit and symbol required.

post.description: Open registration creates a user and revocable human session without global permissions or projects. Server password policy applies.

post.description: Opaque token exchange and single-use refresh rotation. Codes expire in exactly sixty seconds; access expires in at most ten minutes; families expire within eight hours of consent and cannot outlive the parent human session. Refresh replay atomically revokes its entire family. All issuance and rotations require current stored authority and transactional audit. Credentials are returned only after commit, with Cache-Control: no-store.
